q_048a0a7c15.explanation: Nitroglycerin is a venodilator that drops preload, so the formulary sets an SBP floor of >100 mmHg for the SL route. The >90 figure belongs to the infusion target and the >120 figure to the IV bolus.

q_a807c943d5.stem: Which phosphodiesterase inhibitor bars nitroglycerin if taken within the previous 24 hours (rather than the 48-hour window)?
q_a807c943d5.explanation: Nitroglycerin has two exclusion windows: sildenafil within 24 hours, and vardenafil or tadalafil within 48 hours. Combining either with a nitrate can produce profound, refractory hypotension.
